field_of_expertise.detail: Crew Journalist; former finalist in a private crewed Mars mission selection program

source_citation: SRC-mars160-fmars-crew-arrival, SpaceFlight Insider, 'Mars 160: 6-person crew arrives at Arctic station', July 2017: Crew Journalist described as Russian, a former finalist in a private crewed Mars mission selection program. Role and nationality independently corroborated by Mars Society mission materials (mars160.marssociety.org/meet-the-crew/).
